v4_case_fields.absent_field_rule: Retain null/PENDING until source-bound actual evidence; a closed failure may explicitly mark NOT_PRODUCED with a source-bound reason. Never fill absent state/image/parameter/geometry data with zero arrays.
v4_case_fields.closed_failure_rule: Preserve nonzero native and reader exits; review failure evidence without promoting it to PASS. Parent notification and review precede final snapshot.
v4_case_fields.wait_reference_rule: Bind actual wait PID/startticks, raw status, exact log/source SHA and producer/observer closure graph; exit0 alone is insufficient
